summary: Corteva filed an 8-K disclosing that Vylor, its wholly owned subsidiary to house the seed business in a planned separation, issued $1.1B senior notes: $550M 5.125% notes due 2031 and $550M 5.625% notes due 2036, sold privately under Regulation S. Proceeds will fund the seed business ahead of the spin-off, consistent with the October 2025 board-approved plan to divide Corteva into crop protection and seed companies. The notes carry guarantees from relevant entities, not yet registered. Watch for the separation timeline, capital allocation details, and regulatory approvals.
